description: Employee onboarding built with SvGrid Base for Svelte 5: People, their Checklist and Departments as linked tables. A hiring pipeline, a photo directory, start dates on a calendar and a new hire form; each new hire gets a checklist for IT, HR and their manager automatically.

faq.question: What happens when someone is added?
faq.answer: An automation on People runs when a record is created, from Add row or from the form: it sets the status, creates three checklist items for IT, HR and the manager, each linked back to the person, and shows a notice.

faq.question: Can the checklist change?
faq.answer: Yes: open 3 automations in the view bar and edit the items, their owners and due dates, or add more actions.

faq.question: Which license does it need?
faq.answer: SvGrid Base is part of the Suite edition of @svgrid/enterprise. Without a key it runs with a watermark, so it can be evaluated as is.
